remarks:
*Open house Sunday, 10/18/2026, from 11:00 AM–12:30 PM.* Impeccable 4-bedroom, 2-full-bath home featuring two kitchens, an in-law suite, and additional living space! The first floor offers an oversized primary bedroom with an attached dressing room, a spacious second bedroom, and hardwood floors throughout. The kitchen features high-end black stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and Corian countertops, opening to a spacious living room with gas fireplace and large picture window. A formal dining room and full bathroom complete the first floor. Upstairs, you'll find another oversized bedroom, sitting room, and built-in storage with crawl space access. The lower level offers a bedroom, second kitchen, living room, full bathroom with walk-in shower, separate laundry area, and mechanical room. Major updates include a new furnace and A/C (2023), roof tear-off and replacement (2024), hot water tank (2024), gutters with leaf guards (2024), and garage door (2025). Enjoy the fully fenced backyard with gardens, patio, and shed! 

Delayed Negotiations begin Friday, 10/23/2026 at 3:00 PM.
